History
Arcane Healing was first introduced in the Trial mission The Law of Retribution, which was retired in Update 22.14 (2018-03-01).
The Operation: Scarlet Spear event sold Arcane Healing from Little Duck for 1,500  Scarlet Credits.
The Operation: Orphix Venom event sold Arcane Healing from Father for 300  Phasic Cells.
The Operation: Gargoyle's Cry event sold Arcane Healing from the Vigile Jahu Gargoyle for 3  Grotesque Splinter.
The Operation: Belly of the Beast event sold Arcane Healing from Ordis for 1  Volatile Motes in the first run of the event, and 2 Motes in the second, with a purchase limit of 42.

Notes
A Rank 5 Arcane Healing provides total immunity  Radiation proc.
